{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2, so safe to drop)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
grouped = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the mean flipper length for each species
print(grouped)

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = grouped.idxmax()
highest_mean = grouped.max()

# Output the result
print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}")
print(f"Mean flipper length: {highest_mean}")"}
